title: Missing PartialEq on SseFrame, WebSocketCapability, ClientConfig
description: SseFrame, WebSocketCapability, and ClientConfig are public types that lack PartialEq. All three could derive it: SseFrame { event: SseEvent (has PartialEq), id: Option<String> }; WebSocketCapability { url: String, supports_push: bool }; ClientConfig { request_timeout: Duration, and u64 fields }. Without PartialEq, callers and test code must compare field-by-field — this is an unnecessary burden for types that are naturally comparable. The review protocol flags missing derives as a maintainability issue (missing PartialEq/Eq on types used in assertions or sets). Add #[derive(PartialEq)] to these three types. Also add Eq where appropriate (all three qualify since all fields are Eq).
